description: End-to-end YOLO26n object detection pipeline for industrial bottle quality control on a simulated conveyor belt. Dataset built from scratch via manual image capture and annotation.

model.weights_file: models/best_bigcola.pt (final-epoch last.pt of the augmented run)
model.note: The augmented run was interrupted by a Colab disconnect and resumed from last.pt at epoch 96 of 100; hyperparameters unchanged.

dataset.name: Big Cola Bottles Quality Control Dataset
dataset.source: Manually captured: physical bottles on a black-paper conveyor simulation

training_split.split_strategy: Grouped by source scene: augmented versions always in the same split as their source image (leakage-safe). Frozen; manifests in splits/.
training_split.manifest_hash_method: SHA-256 of the sorted manifest lines joined by newline

latency_tesla_t4_ms.protocol: batch 1, 50 warm-up calls discarded, 500 timed calls, CUDA-synchronized

decision: TensorRT FP16 selected. INT8 rejected: -1.6 points mAP50-95 and no speedup over FP16 at batch 1.
limitations: Trained on a simulated conveyor environment (black paper background); may need fine-tuning for real factory lighting conditions
Small dataset (376 raw images) and only 57 validation images; single seed. Per-class differences of a point or two are within noise
mAP50 and recall are saturated, so the augmentation gain is in box tightness (mAP50-95)
TensorRT engines are tied to the GPU architecture and TensorRT version and are not committed
intended_use: Quality control detection of Big Cola bottle conditions on a conveyor belt. Classifies bottles as perfect, empty, missing cap, missing label, or crooked cap.
pipeline_notes: Nine issues (eight pipeline bugs and one benchmarking lesson) are documented in docs/engineering_debrief.md. Results come from the October 2026 clean rerun, which fixed Bug 8 (validation set changed between sessions) and Bug 9 (GaussNoise argument ignored).
